title: FrontDesk AI tickets (version 2.0.1)
description: A ticket as GET /api/tickets sends it to the staff page. In the store a ticket also has chat_id, the key to the patient's chat; it is taken out before the list leaves the server.

id.description: Made by the server when the ticket is opened.

status.description: urgent: emergency. needs human: a booking request or a question that is not in the clinic file. answered: after a staff reply. closed: after Close.

priority.description: P1 emergency, P2 booking request, P3 not in the clinic file.

text.description: The patient's question. A booking ticket adds the requested day, the calendar date in India and the time in brackets.

reply.description: The latest staff reply, or null.
